Name: Sales YoY % Comparable
Expression:
VAR SelectedYear =
    SELECTEDVALUE(
        DimDate[CalendarYear],
        MAX(DimDate[CalendarYear])
    )

VAR DataStart =
    CALCULATE(
        MIN(FactSales[OrderDate]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate)
    )

VAR DataEnd =
    CALCULATE(
        MAX(FactSales[OrderDate]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate)
    )

VAR CurrentStart =
    MAX(
        DATE(SelectedYear, 1, 1),
        DataStart
    )

VAR CurrentEnd =
    MIN(
        DATE(SelectedYear, 12, 31),
        DataEnd
    )

VAR PreviousStart =
    MAX(
        DATE(SelectedYear - 1, 1, 1),
        DataStart
    )

VAR PreviousEnd =
    MIN(
        DATE(SelectedYear - 1, 12, 31),
        DataEnd
    )

VAR ComparableStart =
    MAX(
        CurrentStart,
        EDATE(PreviousStart, 12)
    )

VAR ComparableEnd =
    MIN(
        CurrentEnd,
        EDATE(PreviousEnd, 12)
    )

VAR PreviousComparableStart =
    EDATE(ComparableStart, -12)

VAR PreviousComparableEnd =
    EDATE(ComparableEnd, -12)

VAR CurrentSales =
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DATESBETWEEN(
            DimDate[FullDate],
            ComparableStart,
            ComparableEnd
        )
    )

VAR PreviousSales =
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DATESBETWEEN(
            DimDate[FullDate],
            PreviousComparableStart,
            PreviousComparableEnd
        )
    )

RETURN
    IF(
        SelectedYear <= YEAR(DataStart)
            || PreviousComparableStart < DataStart,
        BLANK(),
        DIVIDE(
            CurrentSales - PreviousSales,
            PreviousSales
        )
    )

Name: Sales Rolling 30D
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Sales],
    DATESINPERIOD(
        DimDate[FullDate],
        MAX(DimDate[FullDate]),
        -30,
        DAY
    )
)

Name: Customer First Purchase Date
Expression:
VAR AsOfDate = [Analysis Date]
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        MIN(FactSales[OrderDate]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
    )

Name: Customer Last Purchase Date
Expression:
VAR AsOfDate = [Analysis Date]
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        MAX(FactSales[OrderDate]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
    )

Name: Days Since Last Purchase
Expression:
VAR LastPurchase = [Customer Last Purchase Date]
RETURN
    IF(
        NOT ISBLANK(LastPurchase),
        DATEDIFF(
            LastPurchase,
            [Analysis Date],
            DAY
        )
    )

Name: Customer Base
Expression:
VAR AsOfDate = [Analysis Date]

RETURN
    COUNTROWS(
        CALCULATETABLE(
            VALUES(FactSales[CustomerID]),
            REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
            DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
        )
    )

Name: Active Customers
Expression:
VAR AsOfDate = [Analysis Date]

VAR CustomerList =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(FactSales[CustomerID]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
    )

RETURN
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            CustomerList,

            VAR LastPurchase =
                CALCULATE(
                    MAX(FactSales[OrderDate]),
                    REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
                    DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
                )

            RETURN
                DATEDIFF(
                    LastPurchase,
                    AsOfDate,
                    DAY
                ) <= 90
        )
    )

Name: Inactive Customers
Expression:
VAR AsOfDate = [Analysis Date]

VAR CustomerList =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(FactSales[CustomerID]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
    )

RETURN
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            CustomerList,

            VAR LastPurchase =
                CALCULATE(
                    MAX(FactSales[OrderDate]),
                    REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
                    DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
                )

            RETURN
                DATEDIFF(
                    LastPurchase,
                    AsOfDate,
                    DAY
                ) > 90
        )
    )

Name: Repeat Customers
Expression:
VAR AsOfDate = [Analysis Date]

VAR CustomerList =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(FactSales[CustomerID]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
    )

RETURN
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            CustomerList,

            VAR Orders =
                CALCULATE(
                    DISTINCTCOUNT(FactSales[SalesOrderID]),
                    REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
                    DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
                )

            RETURN Orders > 1
        )
    )

Name: Customer Lifetime Sales
Expression:
VAR AsOfDate = [Analysis Date]

RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
    )

Name: Customer Lifetime Orders
Expression:
VAR AsOfDate = [Analysis Date]

RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Orders],
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[FullDate] <= AsOfDate
    )

Name: Customer Rank
Expression:
VAR CurrentCustomerSales =
    [Customer Lifetime Sales]

RETURN
    RANKX(
        ALLSELECTED(DimCustomer),
        [Customer Lifetime Sales],
        CurrentCustomerSales,
        DESC,
        DENSE
    )

Name: New Customers
Expression:
VAR PeriodStart =
    MIN(DimDate[FullDate])

VAR PeriodEnd =
    MAX(DimDate[FullDate])

VAR CustomerList =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(FactSales[CustomerID]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[FullDate] <= PeriodEnd
    )

RETURN
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            CustomerList,

            VAR FirstPurchase =
                CALCULATE(
                    MIN(FactSales[OrderDate]),
                    REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate)
                )

            RETURN
                FirstPurchase >= PeriodStart
                    &&
                FirstPurchase <= PeriodEnd
        )
    )

Name: Customer Last Purchase Date Display
Expression:
IF(
    ISINSCOPE(DimCustomer[CustomerName]),
    [Customer Last Purchase Date],
    BLANK()
)

Name: Days Since Last Purchase Display
Expression:
IF(
    ISINSCOPE(DimCustomer[CustomerName]),
    [Days Since Last Purchase],
    BLANK()
)

Name: Product Profit Rank
Expression:
VAR CurrentProfit =
    [Total Profit]

VAR ProductSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(DimProduct[ProductID]),
        ALLSELECTED(DimProduct)
    )

RETURN
    RANKX(
        ProductSet,
        CALCULATE([Total Profit]),
        CurrentProfit,
        DESC,
        DENSE
    )

Name: Product Rank
Expression:
IF(
    ISINSCOPE(DimProduct[ProductName]),
    RANKX(
        ALLSELECTED(DimProduct),
        [Total Sales],
        ,
        DESC,
        DENSE
    ),
    BLANK()
)

Name: Salesperson Rank
Expression:
IF(
    ISINSCOPE(DimSalesPerson[SalesPersonName]),

    RANKX(
        FILTER(
            ALLSELECTED(DimSalesPerson),
            DimSalesPerson[SalesPersonID] <> -1
        ),
        [Total Sales],
        ,
        DESC,
        DENSE
    ),

    BLANK()
)

Name: Salesperson Sales Contribution %
Expression:
IF(
    ISINSCOPE(DimSalesPerson[SalesPersonName]),

    DIVIDE(
        [Total Sales],

        CALCULATE(
            [Total Sales],
            FILTER(
                ALLSELECTED(DimSalesPerson),
                DimSalesPerson[SalesPersonID] <> -1
            )
        ),

        0
    ),

    BLANK()
)
